name: voice
description: Talk to Atlas by voice, through OpenAI or Gemini: Atlas speaks when you ask, and a live voice conversation hands the work to Atlas. Writing audio down and dictation are Atlas's own.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Your OpenAI API key, the one Atlas's OpenAI provider uses, for the voice through OpenAI. The live conversation costs US$ 0.05 a minute, silence included.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Your Gemini API key, the one Atlas's Gemini provider uses, for the voice through Gemini.

settings.name: provider
settings.description: Who speaks and talks: openai or gemini, each with its key above.

settings.name: speech_model
settings.description: The model that speaks Atlas's answers when you ask to hear them; empty for the provider's own choice.

settings.name: live_model
settings.description: The full-duplex voice model of the live conversation; empty for the provider's own choice.

settings.name: voice
settings.description: The voice that speaks, in the live conversation and in audio answers; empty for the provider's own choice.

settings.name: voice_turns_model
settings.description: The model that answers what you ask in the live conversation, with no reasoning: one of Atlas's models, "conversation" for the conversation's own, or empty for the provider's own choice.

settings.name: quiet_close_seconds
settings.description: The live conversation closes after this many seconds of silence, since silence is billed too; 0 never closes it.

settings.name: api_url
settings.description: The provider's API address, empty for its own; another one only for a compatible server, or for tests.
